moments.author: Carlos Alcaraz
moments.why: His social‑media comeback after four months out has tennis fans and men 25‑45 buzzing ahead of the US Open.

moments.author: Jannik Sinner
moments.quote: We have had to make the difficult decision that I will not be able to compete at the US Open this year…I still need more time to recover from my right knee issue.
moments.why: World No. 1 withdrawing from a Grand Slam shocks the tennis world and reshapes the US Open draw.
moments.url: CBS Sports reporting his Instagram/X statement

moments.author: ESPN FC
moments.quote: Robert Lewandowski pulled up to watch Caitlin Clark and the Indiana Fever in Chicago
moments.why: Unexpected cross‑sport appearance of a soccer superstar courtside at WNBA game is trending among men for its novelty.

moments.author: ESPN
moments.quote: No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza ready for his second preseason game — Year 2 off to a strong start for Woody Marks
